title: ExplorerModuleCard
responsibility: Renders catalog and relationship cards with optional revision-scoped images and up to three flat Used In links.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.row
inputs.description: Selected module or support dependency with its actual identity and revision-scoped consumers.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation preserving branch, commit, entity and selected helper.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.mediaBase
inputs.description: URL prefix for the selected evidence assets.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.category
inputs.description: Optional category, defaulting to JavaScript undefined and the row category when available. Null also uses that fallback. Visual and nonvisual cards share this renderer.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.shot
inputs.description: Optional own capture, defaulting to JavaScript undefined. Visual rows then resolve their own capture through lens; null explicitly shows a gap. Nonvisual rows omit the image region.

outputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard
outputs.description: One name or helper invocation, its own image for visual modules, and at most three distinct Used In links followed by an ellipsis. Page cards omit an empty Used In row. Unsupported dependencies have no invented detail link.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Function-card argument examples cannot serialize BigInt or circular values.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Serializing a deeply nested function argument example can exceed the runtime stack.

errors.name: Example serialization callback error
errors.description: A getter, proxy or toJSON method on an example value can throw while its invocation is serialized.

errors.name: nav.href callback error
errors.description: An error from the address callback propagates while rendering the card or a consumer link.

errors.name: nav.go callback error
errors.description: An error from the navigation callback propagates when a card or consumer link is activated.

errors.name: nav.source callback error
errors.description: An error from the source-opening callback propagates when a consumer's source button is activated.

errors.name: lens.evidence callback error
errors.description: An evidence callback error propagates while resolving the card image or opening a visual consumer preview.
